origin: charge center O; A negative z, B positive z
phase: positive meridional exact lowest fixed sector; real cos(phi) bright
norm: integral rho d rho dz amplitude^2=1
delta: dimensionless (E_b_physical-E_g_physical)/E_A; distinct from same-sector Ritz gap
frame: static charge-center electronic problem; no collision ETF propagation
force_geometry: unit-charge W_C=-1/r_C; defined even for Z_C=0 fixtures
signed_nuclear_position_symbol: a_C^(num), distinct from length unit a_A
finite_box: B-centered Dirichlet sphere; O torque may contain measured surface stress
reported_digits: reproducibility digits, not continuum accuracy digits
